rules.pre_revenue: revenue under $25M over four quarters and operating income ≤ 0 (a pipeline no filing prices)
rules.pre_profit: operating income ≤ 0 over four quarters and revenue growth ≥ 10%

implied_return.note: The yearly return a buyer at today's price earns if each model's assumptions hold (an implied cost of capital). Above the cost of equity: the price leaves room; below: the price already asks for more than the models deliver.

inputs: SEC XBRL frames: diluted weighted-average shares
assumptions: a fixed assumption (long-run US average, not estimated here) · market today: 2.40%

wacc.formula: WACC = wₑ × kₑ + w_d × k_d × (1 − t);  kₑ = r_f + β × ERP
steps: β (Blume-adjusted) = 0.67 × raw β — + 0.33 = 1.00  (fewer than 52 weeks of prices: beta 1.0 assumed)
k_d = 6.32%  (5-year Treasury 4.91% + model spread 141 bp (bond-calibrated, app/debt.py)); after tax 6.32% × (1 − 21%) = 4.99%

methods.formula: Value per share = (equity − goodwill − intangibles) ÷ shares, floored at 0; low end × 0.8
assumptions: an assumption (XBRL frames carry no asset-level haircuts)
methods.fit: At the pre-revenue stage what its assets would fetch matters; tangible book is $1.11 a share.

methods.formula: Net cash per share = (cash − debt − other claims) ÷ diluted shares, floored at 0
steps: Market-implied value of the pipeline (EV) = market value − net cash = $2.99B − −$1.82B = $4.82B
inputs: SEC XBRL frames: diluted weighted-average shares
assumptions: a floor: no filing prices a drug trial or an unlaunched product
methods.fit: It is pre-revenue (— of revenue over four quarters, with an operating loss): its cash is the one solid number, and the rest of the price is a bet on its pipeline.

methods.formula: Stage-weighted value = Σ weight × central value of the stage's methods (weights renormalized over the methods available)
assumptions: fixed by stage before any result was seen (base_rates.STAGES)
methods.fit: Its stage is “Pre-revenue” — revenue not reported over four quarters, operating income ≤ 0 — which fixes these methods and their weights in advance.
